items.note: A full-width teal band holds the 'Profile' title in regular-weight ink with a 1px ink rule under it. Below it are a pill sub-nav (current page filled ink) and one outlined raised card with ink-bordered inputs and a square initials avatar. The save row pairs a pink 'Save changes' with a ghost 'Reset', which matches the spec's settings recipe of band, pills and a lifted save row.

The band collapses to the title and lead, and the sub-nav becomes a scrolling pill strip ('Billing' is cropped at the edge, so it reads as scrollable). The form is a single column inside one outlined card. The full-width pink save and ghost reset sit in the flow with no fixed bar, and nothing overlaps.

The ground is black with a dark raised card and light borders. The teal band keeps ink text, the current sub-nav pill flips to a paper fill, and pink stays the single primary action. This follows the spec's dark mapping and the reference's dark pages.

Same structure as mobile light on a black ground with a dark card. The band text stays ink on teal, the selected pill is paper-filled, the inputs have light outlines and readable values, and the pink save sits next to an outlined reset.

The teal band carries the title, a lead and an outlined count pill ('3 of 6 notifications on') in ink. Two outlined cards ('Email', 'Push notifications') follow, with hairline-ruled rows, each pairing an On/Off word with a pink-filled switch, so status is never shown by color alone.

The band wraps the lead over two lines with the count pill underneath, and the pill strip shows 'Notifications' ink-filled. In the stacked cards, each row puts the label and description on the left and the On/Off word plus switch on the right, with even row rhythm and nothing cramped.

In dark, the band stays teal with ink text, and the count pill takes a light outline. The cards are dark raised panels with light rules, and switches use a pink fill with a dark knob when on and outlined tracks when off. The hierarchy matches the light version.

In the original, the band title, lead and count pill are all ink on teal and readable. Below are a paper-filled current pill and two dark outlined cards whose toggle rows sit on consistent hairline rules with the On/Off words next to each switch.

The teal 'Security' band is followed by an outlined 'Change password' card: three ink-bordered inputs, helper text and one pink 'Update password'. Under a 1px rule, 'Active sessions' is a bordered table with a tinted header, a 'This device' status pill and small outlined 'Revoke' row-action buttons.

The band, pill strip and one-column password card with a full-width pink submit are all correct. The sessions table scrolls inside its bordered box, though: at 390px only the Device column and a clipped Location column show, and every 'Revoke' action is off-screen to the right.

Black ground and a dark outlined password card with a pink submit. The sessions table has light borders, the 'This device' pill is outlined and the 'Revoke' buttons are outlined. The band text stays ink on teal and everything is readable.

This is the dark version of mobile light and has the same problem. The password form is clean and full-width, but the sessions table clips mid-word at the Location column and the 'Revoke' actions can only be reached by sideways scrolling inside the box.

Three outlined plan cards each carry a pink price tag and a checklist. The current plan has a thicker border and a 'Current plan' pill, and the other two have ghost switch buttons. A small pink coin sticker sits beside 'Plans', followed by an outlined payment-method row and an invoice table with outlined Paid/Due status pills that pair an icon with a word.

The plans stack as full-width outlined cards with pink price tags and ghost switch buttons, and a 1px rule separates the payment method and invoices sections. The four-column invoice table fits at 390px without clipping, and the 'Billing' pill is ink-filled in the strip.

Dark raised plan cards keep their pink price tags. The current plan is outlined in light, and the small sticker next to 'Plans' stays pink. The invoice table has light rules with outlined status pills, and the band holds ink text on teal.

Stacked dark plan cards with pink tags and outlined switch buttons, a payment row, and an invoice table that fits the width. The status pills pair an icon with a word, and the 'Billing' pill is paper-filled in the strip. Nothing is cut off.

findings.summary: On mobile, the sessions table scrolls sideways inside its box, which pushes the per-row 'Revoke' action out of view. It can only be found by scrolling past a column that is clipped mid-word.
findings.promptFix: Under breakpoint.md, a table whose rows carry actions shows each row as a stacked, rule-separated block (primary value, meta line, then the row action), or pins the action column to the right edge, so no row action is hidden behind horizontal scroll.
